sentences.text:
Smt. Sarita Saxena vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June,
2023
Author: Anuradha Shukla

Bench: Anuradha Shukla
In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur Cra No. 5883 of 2023 (Smt.
Sarita Saxena Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) Dated : 21-06-2023 Shri S. M. Guru -
Advocate for the appellant.

entities.text: High Court Of Madhya Pradesh At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Smt. Seema Sahu - Panel Lawyer for the State.
Heard on the question of admission.
The appeal being arguable is admitted.
Also heard on I.A No.9431/2023, which is firs t application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

T h e appellant has been convicted for the offences punishable under Section 120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 2 years RI with a fine of Rs.1000/-, section 467/120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 7 years RI with a fine of Rs.4000/-, section 468/120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years RI with a fine of Rs.3,000/-, section 471/120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 2 years RI with a fine of Rs.1,000/- and section 420/120-B of IPC and sentenced to undergo 3 years RI with a fine of Rs.1,000/-, with default stipulations.
All the sentences are directed to run concurrently.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the matter.

Learned counsel for the appellant has submitted that the trial Court has not properly appreciated the oral and documentary evidence available on record and committed error in convicting the appellant for aforesaid offences.
The appellant is in jail since 20.4.2023.
He further submits that there is no likelihood of hearing of appeal in near future.
Hence, it is prayed that the application for suspension of sentence may be considered.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposes the application and prays for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the parties, perused the record and the judgment of the court below.
O n due consideration of the submissions made on behalf of the appellant, I find it appropriate to suspend the jail sentence of the appellant.
Accordingly, I.A. filed on behalf of the appellant is allowed.

sentences.text: It is directed that subject to deposit of fine amount, if already not deposited and on furnishing a personal bond by the appellant in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court for her regular appearance before the concerned trial Court, the execution of custodial part of the remaining sentence imposed against the appellant shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this appeal.

The appellant, after being enlarged on bail, shall mark her presence before the concerned trial Court on 29.09.2023 and on all such subsequent dates, which are fixed in this regard by the concerned trial Court.
List for final hearing in due course.
Certified Copy as per rules.
